ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all UBOs, shareholders, directors, authorized signatories, and beneficial-owner proxies against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, Vietnamese judicial and public-security wanted lists, State Bank of Viet Nam published AML/sanctions references, and, where applicable, EU/UK consolidated sanctions lists. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), their families and close associates must be subject to enhanced due diligence under Law No.09/2022/QH15, including source-of-wealth verification and senior-management approval before proceeding with the investment.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) — https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory enterprise name must be expressed in the Vietnamese language and contain two elements: (a) the enterprise type phrase, e.g., 'Công ty TNHH' for a limited liability company, and (b) the proper name consisting of letters, numerals, and permitted symbols. A foreign-invested company may use an additional English or romanized business name enclosed in parentheses immediately following the Vietnamese proper name. All transliterations and Vietnamese accents must comply with the standards set by Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP; names must not be confusingly similar to an already registered enterprise or a protected trademark.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names already registered in the National Enterprise Database
Names considered confusingly similar to an existing or dissolved but still protected enterprise name
Names contrary to national history, culture, morals, public order, traditions, or the collective good
Names including state-agency, political-organization, armed-force, or local-government designations (e.g., 'Chính phủ', 'Công an', 'Quân đội', 'Ủy ban')
Financial-sector protected tokens ('Ngân hàng', 'Bank', 'Bảo hiểm', 'Insurance', 'Chứng khoán', 'Securities', 'Quỹ', 'Fund') unless a separate statutory license has been obtained
The token 'Vietnam / Việt Nam' when used in a manner suggesting state sponsorship or a falsely exclusive national right
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, Vietnamese law does not create a standalone pre-registration name reservation right. A proposed name is only secured when the complete enterprise registration dossier is accepted and the Enterprise Registration Certificate is issued. If the name is rejected on grounds of confusion or prohibited tokens, the applicant may resubmit an amended dossier with a revised name within the reply period set by the provincial Department of Planning and Investment. An administrative appeal may be filed with the provincial competent authority within 30 days of rejection, followed by an appeal to the Ministry of Planning and Investment under the Law on Handling of Administrative Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13; the investor may subsequently initiate judicial review under the Administrative Procedure Law No. 24/2011/QH14.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for the virtual-office CMRA / mail-scanning industry provided that the registered address is a physical address in Viet Nam that can lawfully receive official notices, tax documents, and court service documents; a P.O. Box or an address offered without a physical reception or governance capability will not satisfy the enterprise registration requirement. The CMRA enterprise must retain a legitimate service agreement for the address, maintain records accessible to authorities, and the investor may use its registered virtual-office address strictly in accordance with the Law on Enterprises and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP. The virtual-office service itself must be operated by a licensed Vietnamese business under ISIC 8299 and is acceptable for tax invoicing, mail scanning, and digital correspondence if the entity maintains at least one authorized representative or employee available during normal business hours.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate estimated risk of 10%-15% within the first 12 months of registration. Unannounced inspections may be conducted by tax authorities under the Tax Administration Law No. 38/2019/QH14, by registration authorities under the Law on Enterprises, or by public-security units evaluating money-laundering and commercial-substance risks. The likelihood increases if the registered address serves multiple unrelated virtual-office clients, if postal/tax notifications are returned, or if VAT and enterprise income tax filings show characteristics inconsistent with the declared CMRA activity.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 15, 20, 21, 22, 23, 46 and 47) and Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 22, 26, 27, 37 and 38), as implemented by Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration and Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP on Investment Registration; supplementary rules on conditional business lines under Decree No. 47/2020/ND-CP on Postal Services.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the Provincial People's Committee where the registered office is located, operating through the National Enterprise Registration Portal and the National Investment Registration System; the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI) for high-level investment approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Combined Application for Investment Registration (Form A-2/ĐKĐT), Application for Enterprise Registration (Form A-01/DK), the Company Charter, and the list of founding members/members (Form A-03/DK); issued as Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: For a virtual office and mail scanning LLC, no industry-specific legal capital (minimum charter capital) is imposed; the company must nevertheless declare its charter capital in the ERC and fully contribute it within 90 days after issuance of the ERC in accordance with Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises 2020. Capital is paid into a corporate bank account opened in the company's name; no escrow or blocked account is statutorily required, but the DPI and tax authorities may require contribution evidence, and any later change in contributed capital must be registered by a supplementary filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING MEMBERS/MEMBER OF [COMPANY NAME] (LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY, FOREIGN INVESTED), ADOPTED BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT IN LIEU OF A PHYSICAL MEETING ON [DATE], AT [CITY/ADDRESS]: WHEREAS the Member(s) of the company wish to formalize the organization of the company; NOW BE IT RESOLVED: 1. SUBSCRIPTION OF SHARE CAPITAL: The initial charter capital of the company is fixed at [VND amount] and the Member(s) hereby subscribe to the whole of the contributed capital in the ratios set out in the Company Charter. The Chairman of the Members' Council/General Director is instructed to open a corporate bank account and effect full capital contribution within 90 days from the date of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. 2. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office (head office) of the company is hereby fixed and adopted at [exact street address, ward/commune, district, province/city, Vietnam]. The registered office is the place of central management of the company; the company shall place its corporate seal there and maintain the accounting and corporate records at this address. 3. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS: The company shall have one member, and the Member appoints [NAME] as Chairman of the Members' Council, [NAME] as General Director, and [NAME] as Legal Representative. The Legal Representative is authorized to execute all application forms, contracts, and declarations necessary for the IRC and ERC filing, bank account opening, seal making, and licensing procedures. 4. POWER TO REGISTER: The Legal Representative is hereby irrevocably empowered to sign, notarize, file, and receive all certificates, to publish the registration on the National Business Registration Portal, and to take all actions necessary to place the company in good standing under Vietnamese law. This Resolution is effective immediately and shall bind the company and all successors.
incorporation_legal_framework.note_on_fee: The state registration fee for the ERC and IRC is officially waived; a nominal online publication fee of approximately VND 100,000 (about USD 4) is payable under step 4, and ancillary notarial and translation fees are payable to private notary offices.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Localization of All Incorporation Dossiers and Execution of Lease of Registered Office Premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vietnam Notary Public Offices (Phòng Công chứng) and Office Notarization (Văn phòng công chứng) recognized by the provincial Department of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the passport and national identity papers of the foreign founding member/member and the appointed legal representative; have the Vietnamese- or English-to-Vietnamese translated documents notarized at a licensed Vietnam notary; finalize and sign the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty) and the list of members; secure a verifiable lease contract (Hợp đồng thuê văn phòng) for the physical registered head office, together with the lessor's land-use rights certificate (Giấy chứng nhận quyền sử dụng đất) or building ownership certificate to prove lawful use of the address; notarized copy of the lease must match the exact address that will appear in the IRC and ERC.
required_dossiers: Notarized Vietnamese translation of founding member's/legal representative's passport and visa (and residence certificate, if any)
Company Charter duly signed by all/all member(s)
List of members with subscribed capital amounts (Form A-03/DK)
Notarized office lease contract plus notarized copy of lessor's land/building title
Power of attorney (if a free agent signs)
ID documentation of the authorized signatory
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or DPI rejects any document due to defect, procure a corrected Vietnamese sworn translation or re-notarize with an updated power of attorney; the company may switch notary offices without repaying the state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Investment Registration Certificate for the FDI LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city where the head office is located; submissions are made via the National Investment Registration System (NIRS) or through the one-stop window (Bộ phận Một cửa) of the DPI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: With a foreign investor owning the LLC, first file an Investment Registration Project: describe the project (commercial mail receiving agency, virtual office services, and inbound mail scanning under ISIC 8299), determine the scale and location, and submit together with the lease contract and a certified project explanation. Use Form A-2/ĐKĐT to apply for the IRC. Confirm that the business lines do not fall within market-access restrictions under Vietnam's WTO or CPTPP commitments; virtual office and CMRA services are not on the conditioned market-access list. The DPI evaluates the application within 10 working days if all valid documents are supplied, and within 15 days for projects subject to consultation; the IRC is the first legal warrant allowing the investor to establish the company.
required_dossiers: Investment project proposal and explanation of project (Form A-1/ĐKĐT)
Application for IRC (Form A-2/ĐKĐT)
Photocopy and notarized Vietnamese translation of constitutional documents of the foreign investor (if corporate) or passport (if individual)
Charter and notarized office lease contract
Financial capacity documents of the investor (bank reference, audited financials)
Copy of memorandum of incorporation and good standing certificate for corporate investors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a request for amendment or fails to respond within the statutory time limit, the investor may file a supplementary set of documents within 10 working days, and may appeal the adverse decision to the Provincial People's Committee or initiate administrative court proceedings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Enterprise Registration Certificate and Automatic Tax Identity Assignment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), Business Registration Division (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh); filed through the National Enterprise Registration Portal (Cổng Thông tin Quốc gia về Đăng ký doanh nghiệp) at www.dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after issuance of the IRC, file the Enterprise Registration dossier in the same one-stop window/portal with a valid IRC as an attachment. The DPI will issue the ERC with a permanent Enterprise Code (Mã số doanh nghiệp), which automatically becomes the Tax Identification Number (MST). The ERC records business lines exactly as 'Commercial Mail Receiving Agency (CMRA) and digital document scanning - other business support services not elsewhere classified (ISIC 8299)'. The ERC is the principal certificate of incorporation. The DPI issues the ERC within 3 working days of a complete and valid application.
required_dossiers: Valid IRC (original or certified copy)
Application for Enterprise Registration (Form A-01/DK)
Company Charter (duly signed and notarized)
List of members and subscribed capital details (Form A-03/DK)
Duplicate original of ID/passport of members and legal representative with translated color copies
Decision of the member(s) on appointment of legal representative and the pro forma first board resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI flags incomplete documents, use the portal's electronic file-processing interface (xử lý hồ sơ) and supplement within 10 working days; in case of an outright denial, file an administrative complaint with the Director of the DPI within 10 days and thereafter with the Provincial People's Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of Formation on the National Business Registration Portal and Making of Corporate Seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Enterprise Registration Portal, Ministry of Planning and Investment; the seal is made at licensed seal-engraving enterprises and the seal specimen is declared on the portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days after issuance of the ERC, publish the required formation information (primary lines, capital, address, member's details) on the National Business Registration Portal with a one-off publication fee of approximately USD 4 (VND 100,000). Then make a copper/bronze corporate seal bearing the ERC number; no prior authorization is required for seal-making, but the legal representative must register the seal specimen and signature electronically with the DPI portal after first use. Every legal document must be sealed in conformity with Article 44 of Law on Enterprises 2020.
required_dossiers: ERC and IRC
Username and password for the National Enterprise Registration Portal
Confirmation of payment of publication fee
Seal specimen declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of delays in the online publication, request a manual one-stop-window processing at the DPI and obtain a physical publication acknowledgement; if the seal specimen is rejected, re-register the corrected specimen on the portal within 48 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax and Social Insurance Registration and Activation of Electronic Invoicing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial/City Tax Department (Cục Thuế) via the electronic tax portal (etax.vgac.vn); Social Insurance Agency (Bảo hiểm xã hội Việt Nam); the ERC code serves as the tax identity
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The ERC code becomes the Tax Identification Number. Log in to the Tax Department portal with the authorized digital token/signature, file an initial tax declaration, register the statutory accounting regime, and apply for electronic invoice codes from the General Department of Taxation within 10 days of obtaining the ERC. In parallel, activate a payroll file for mandatory social, health, and unemployment insurance for any employees at the Social Insurance office. For a virtual office and mail-scanning venture, no special invoicing license is needed, but all sales and recurring Stripe invoices must be issued through compliant electronic invoicing templates.
required_dossiers: ERC and IRC
Legal representative's personal identification and digital signature certificate (USB token) from a licensed certification authority
Application for Tax Registration (Form 01-DK-TCT)
Commercial bank account details
Incorporation chart and charter capital contribution plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax account cannot be authenticated, visit the Tax Department to activate the OTP/token and submit Form 01-DK-TCT by paper; any refusal letter must be complied with within 7 working days or appealed to the General Department of Taxation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account, Capital Contribution and Recurring Foreign Payment Infrastructure
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks in Vietnam licensed to accept foreign investment capital (joint-stock banks and foreign bank branches); FDI capital account registration with the State Bank of Vietnam
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a primary corporate account at a Vietnamese licensed bank under the legal representative's authority. If equity is contributed by a foreign investor, open a direct investment capital account (C/B account) once the ERC and IRC are issued. Contribute charter capital within 90 days (extendable once by up to 50 days). Obtain the bank's foreign exchange authorization to receive USD from Stripe for card payments and mail-scan subscription fees under the current transaction regime. All shareholder loans, Stripe credits, and cash withdrawals must be reported to the bank to ensure lawful recurring payment processing.
required_dossiers: ERC and IRC
Resolution of the member(s) on opening of bank accounts
Legal representative's passport and notarized passport translation
Direct investment capital account registration form (if foreign contributed)
Lease contract and corporate seal
Detailed capital contribution plan on the bank's FDI checklist
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank demands additional KYC, provide a notarized English translation of the ERC and a charter capital explanation; if the bank refuses to open the direct investment capital account, obtain a written refusal and apply at another licensed bank; the statutory capital contribution deadline applies regardless of bank query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Physical Premises Fire Safety and Civil Defense Clearance and Fit-Out for Commercial Operation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Fire Prevention and Fighting Police under the provincial Police Department (PC07); District Construction Inspectorate and local People's Committee for building function compliance; Department of Natural Resources and Environment for environmental supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The leased virtual office address must obtain a formal fire prevention and fighting acceptance certificate (Giấy chứng nhận nghiệm thu về phòng cháy và chữa cháy) for the office floor before full operation. Because the premises will serve as a front-of-counter for mail scanning, the lessor must supply structural load and evacuation certificates; install PCCC equipment (extinguishers, exit signs, emergency lighting) and obtain the fire-safety record from the local Fire Police. If any interior fit-out alters the building structure, obtain the construction/refitting permit from the District Construction Inspectorate. The operation of scanners and servers requires compliance with energy-efficiency thresholds and an approved e-waste recycling contract; the office is classified as a non-manufacturing commercial location and does not trigger a full environmental impact assessment.
required_dossiers: Lease contract and IRC/ERC
Fire-fighting equipment installation list and as-built drawing of premises
Structural load records/certification of the building and evacuation plan
Certificate of construction compliance of the lessor
E-waste recycling contract (waste paper, cartridges, electronic scrap)
Photographs and addressed plans for the Fire Police inspection
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire-safety dossier is queried, revise the as-built drawing with the lessor and re-submit to the Fire Police within 7 working days; non-approval may be appealed to the Director of the Provincial Police Department under Articles 10 and 12 of Decree 136/2020/ND-CP.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Postal and Digital-Platform Licensing for Mail Reception and Scanning Activities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Posts under the Ministry of Information and Communications (MIC) for the postal license; MIC online service licensing for website-based mail-scanning delivery
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If the company physically receives letters, parcels, and documents delivered to its designated office address under a CMRA agreement, the arrangement may constitute the value-added postal service of mail receiving and documentation digitisation. File a postal business license application under Decree No. 47/2020/ND-CP with the Department of Posts. The application describes the scope: reception, scanning, digital conversion, and forwarding of electronic notifications. The license is issued when the applicant is an LLC, the postal network facility is specified, premises safety certification is secured, and the managing director has no criminal prohibition. Concurrently, register the internet/online service notice (Giấy xác nhận thông báo cung cấp dịch vụ TTĐT) for the client web portal if mail scanning is delivered over a website; maintain e-invoices integrated with Stripe in the legally recognized IT system.
required_dossiers: Application for postal license (under Decree 47/2020/ND-CP)
ERC/IRC and charter
Proof of professional premises and fire-safety clearance
Operational plan for mail receiving, scanning, and data transmission
Passport and criminal record certificate of the general director
Electronic service notice (Thông báo cung cấp dịch vụ tại Việt Nam)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the postal license application is refused because the activity is deemed not postal but rather a facility-based office service, request a written ruling of the MIC, continue operation under the ERC and tax compliance only, and switch to a registered online service license.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) for enterprise registration and sectoral entry; Department of Posts (Cục Bưu điện) under the Ministry of Information and Communications for postal-type mail receiving and scanning; fire and safety jurisdiction held by the Fire Prevention and Fighting Police, PC07 under the provincial Police Department
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Giấy đăng ký kinh doanh (Enterprise Registration Certificate) with the business line 'Other business support services n.e.c. (ISIC 8299) - commercial mail receiving agency and digital scanning'; where applicable, a Giấy phép cung cấp dịch vụ bưu chính (Postal Service License) for value-added mail reception and a Giấy chứng nhận nghiệm thu về phòng cháy và chữa cháy (Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) of the province/city, coordinating with the Vietnam Environment Administration under the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: No full EIA report or Environmental Impact Assessment certification required; the virtual office and mail-scanning activity is classified as a commercial service installation with no mining or large manufacturing process. The company must file an environmental commitment/self-certification under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP and implement a waste management plan for office paper, e-waste, and general domestic refuse; waste must be collected by a licensed urban environmental company.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: only lavatory and kitchen greywater discharged into the municipal sewer network; no industrial wastewater discharge; if discharge occurs, compliance with National Technical Regulation QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT for domestic wastewater is required. Emissions: no VOC or smoke stack; indoor air is managed under workplace hygiene thresholds; scanning equipment must comply with applicable electrical and energy-efficiency standards; e-waste must be transferred to a certified facility under Circular 01/2022/TT-BTNMT. Waste handling: paper waste, mail envelopes, scanner cartridges, and plastic components are segregated under a company 3R waste management program; each waste carrier must be licensed in compliance with QCVN 50/2013/BTNMT for hazardous refuse.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận nghiệm thu về PCCC) obtained from the provincial Fire Police must be displayed at the registered office; annual checks on evacuation routes and fire-fighting equipment are mandatory. For structural clearance, the lessor must present the completed-construction record and building function certificate demonstrating an office function. Occupational safety: conduct a workplace hazard assessment for screen-equipment workstations, provide compulsory occupational safety training under Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene No. 84/2015/QH13, maintain an occupational safety inspection file for computers and scanning devices, and keep labor and insurance records. Civil defense: the virtual office must have no hazardous storage beyond office supplies, display an evacuation map, and suspend operations during fire guard inspection if the fire safety acceptance is not revalidated.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT), Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Viet Nam. Official transaction portals: EtaxVN tax filing and TIN administration at https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn; national e-invoice portal at https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; National Business Registration Portal at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested LLC obtains its statutory enterprise tax identification number (MST/TIN) automatically upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) through the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI). The foreign investor must first complete investment registration and enterprise registration via the National Business Registration Portal; no separate TIN application is required for the LLC. A foreign company operating in Viet Nam without a locally incorporated entity must instead obtain a contractor TIN and register for the Foreign Contractor Tax regime with the GDT before issuing invoices or receiving Vietnam-source payments.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None for entity status. Viet Nam does not recognize check-the-box elections, transparent/partnership classifications, or elective hybrid-mismatch treatment; the LLC is per se a corporate income tax (CIT) taxpayer. Available administrative elections are limited to VAT accounting method options (credit-invoice deduction method versus direct turnover-based method) and, for qualifying non-resident foreign contractors, election between the deemed Foreign Contractor Tax and ordinary CIT registration, in each case subject to GDT approval and statutory documentation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT), a credit-invoice consumption tax administered by the GDT; no separate GST or state-level sales and use tax exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 100,000,000 annual revenue threshold for business households and individuals below which VAT registration and output VAT are not required; no turnover threshold applies to an LLC, which must register for VAT immediately upon enterprise registration and before any taxable supply activity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing applies to all enterprises from 1 July 2022. Invoices must be issued as electronic invoices bearing a tax-authority code (hoá đơn điện tử có mã của cơ quan thuế) in standardized XML/JSON format, transmitted to the GDT e-invoice portal in near real time through a registered service-provider API. The GDT validates each invoice and returns a digital tax-authority code and QR stamp before the invoice is legally usable; invoice records and underlying transaction data must be retained for at least 10 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to goods and services genuinely supplied to non-resident persons and consumed outside Viet Nam. The claim requires a signed cross-border export or service contract, evidence that performance and consumption occurred outside Vietnam, foreign-currency payment received through an authorized Vietnamese commercial bank, and, for goods, completion of electronic customs export procedures. A virtual-office/mail-scanning service qualifies as an exported service only where the recipient obtains the benefit entirely outside Viet Nam, the contract and payment trail identify the non-resident recipient, and the service has no connected Vietnam-located property or local use.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic customs export entry) for physical exports; not required for pure cross-border digital service exports
Signed international sales or service contract with the non-resident counterparty
Commercial invoice and GDT-coded export e-invoice
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or transport document for goods; for services, signed delivery report or performance log proving overseas consumption
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC), bank foreign-payment confirmation, or authorized commercial bank statement evidencing receipt of foreign currency
Packing list, certificate of origin, and export insurance documents where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: GDT and Customs cross-check zero-rating claims against customs declarations, e-invoice data, annual CIT filings, bank settlement records, and IRC documentation. An erroneous or fraudulent export zero-rating claim is reopened within the statutory assessment period; the VAT input credit and refund are retrospectively clawed back, the due VAT is reassessed, and late-payment interest applies at the statutory rate (0.03% per day). Administrative penalties range from fines to 1–3 times the evaded VAT, and deliberate export VAT refund fraud, e-invoice forgery, or customs evasion may attract criminal prosecution, suspension of the taxpayer's e-invoice account, cancellation of tax-clearance status, and denial of future zero-rating privileges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV / Ngan Hang Nha Nuoc Viet Nam), including the Foreign Exchange Administration Department (FXD) and provincial SBV provincial branches, with the Government of Vietnam issuing FX ordinances and circulars.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vietnam operates a managed float regime with tight capital controls and partial convertibility. The Vietnamese dong (VND) is not freely convertible offshore; current account transactions—including trade-related transfers and operating expenses—are generally permitted and bankable, subject to verification of underlying documentation. Capital account transactions, including equity injections, shareholder loans, and the issuance of foreign securities, require compliance with the Law on Enterprises, the Law on Investment, Decree 31/2021/ND-CP, SBV Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN, and Circular 02/2021/TT-NHNN. Profit and dividend remittances to foreign shareholders are permitted after the completion of audited annual financial statements and payment of all corporate income tax obligations, subject to an SBV-registered Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA). The SBV sets the daily central reference exchange rate and permits commercial banks to quote rates within a narrow band, limiting arbitrage flexibility. Virtual office and mail scanning businesses are not considered a priority sector; therefore, the entity will undergo enhanced FX compliance scrutiny for remittances, and profit repatriation may be deferred until the audited finalization is approved and prior year deficits are cleared.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SBV Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN (as amended by Circular 02/2021/TT-NHNN), resident entities that directly export goods or services are required to sell a statutory percentage of export foreign-exchange proceeds to a licensed bank. For most exporters, at least 80% of the export proceeds must be converted into VND within 15 working days of receipt, while the remaining 20% may be retained in the exporter's foreign currency account to fund permissible current-account spending. Certain categories—namely Export Processing Enterprises (EPE), entities operating in or for export-processing zones, and entities that are parties to approved Commercial Concession Agreements—may retain a higher proportion of export proceeds, subject to an SBV-provincial approval. For the CMRA / mail scanning entity whose primary revenue is subscription or recurring fee income rather than merchandise exports, the general 80% surrender rule applies to any export of professional services (classified as current-account receipt). The bank will apply a mandatory sale ratio based on the underlying transaction code and will require a qualified Export Title (e.g., Service Contract, Commercial Invoice, Bill of Exchange) to determine the exact removal timeline.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) – International Banking Division

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore fintech electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Stripe, Wise, Airwallex, Rapyd, or similar platforms are not authorized to open deposit accounts or provide banking services to legal entities within Vietnam. SBV and the Payment Directive (Decree 52/2013/ND-CP, amended by Decree 27/2022/ND-CP) confer only upon licensed commercial banks and licensed non-bank payment institutions (e.g., VNPAY, MoMo) the right to process payment transactions for residents. Offshore EMIs may act as a foreign treasury aggregation layer only if (i) the Vietnamese LLC uses them as a non-resident receivable-channel merchant processor, (ii) all settled funds are routed to a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank within the SBV regulatory perimeter, and (iii) the EMI obtains a partnership with an approved foreign-owned bank branch to secure SWIFT pass-through. The feasibility rating is LOW for using an EMI as the primary Vietnamese bank account substitute, but MEDIUM for using an EMI as an invoice-billing and receivable collection facilitator that is contractually backed by a local commercial bank (e.g., via Stripe's Local Payment Method enabling VND-currency settlement). Legal constraints include: EMIs cannot open a DICA or accept FDI capital injection in Vietnam, cannot issue FX surrender certificates, and cannot support SBV-mandated annual balance and transaction reporting. Therefore, the blueprint requires a local tier-1 bank presence as the sole repository for statutory capital and operating funds, with the EMI only integrated as a secondary front-end collection code for credit-card recurring fees.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a 100% foreign-invested LLC under Vietnamese law, the bank's corporate KYC policies mandate that at least one natural person who is the authorized legal representative (either the Chairman of the Member Council or the Company General Director) appear physically at the chosen bank branch for the initial restriction meeting. Under Vietnamese best practice, a foreign national may delegate physical attendance to a local Vietnamese resident who is appointed as legally authorized officer by notarized power of attorney (POA), but only after the bank has verified the POA with the notary and the Investment Registration Certificate / Business Registration Certificate. In practice, the bank will also request a face-to-face interview with the ultimate beneficial owner (including foreign directors) through a bank videoconference system; this is typically mandatory for a foreign-owned LLC whose legal representatives are all physical persons residing overseas. No fully remote corporate account opening is permitted for a Vietnam LLC without any branch visit; at minimum, the local authorized representative must present an immovable-property-verified lease, certificate of incorporation, and original passport. Since the CMRA virtual-office model may raise a risk of shell-company ambiguity, banks will often require an in-person interview at the head office before opening a USD or DICA account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inability to identify ultimate beneficial owners due to an offshore holding-company chain with opaque nominee shareholding
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a full legal entity structure chart evidencing every intermediate holding company, certified copy of the offshore holding company's registry deed, statutory declaration of all natural-person shareholders holding ≥10% equity, passport copies of each UBO, notarized source-of-wealth statement, and a Power of Attorney authenticating the Vietnamese legal representative's authority.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk business classification: Commercial Mail Receiving Agency (CMRA) and digital mail scanning is a Money Service Business adjacency that can facilitate address fraud and mail-drop laundering
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the Vietnam Business Registration Licence, Investment Registration Certificate with full business scope using ISIC/NAICS 8299/561431, the virtual-office service agreement with the mail sorting facility, internal AML/CFT policy, a verified client list and column regarding the collection of sub-tenants' identification, and a data-security compliance statement under Decree 13/3033 on personal data protection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign capital injection originating from high-risk jurisdictions or from a jurisdiction with FATF grey-list status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Organise a legalized bank draft showing the remitting bank's SWIFT stack, certified source of funds documentation (contract of loan, equity purchase agreement), annual financial statements of the remitting corporate shareholder, and a board resolution of the Vietnamese LLC approving the capital contribution together with tax-compliant receipt acknowledgement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Account activity inconsistent with stated business model: expected credit-card recurring revenues from international clients but banking transactions initiated via cable transfers without a merchant-processing agreement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a treasury projection illustrating monthly recurring invoices (typically US$200–$10,000 per client), a master service agreement with the payment gateway (Stripe/PCI-DSS), a copy of the commercial bank's SWIFT payment-incoming authorization, and a clear funds-flow diagram linking the virtual-office contract to each source of bank debit/credit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Missing physical business location: virtual-office licence shows only a PO Box or mail-drop address without a real leased office or physical service centre
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a qrey bare-roof lease agreement over at least 12 months showing the specific address of the mail-sorting centre, evidence of utility bills in the company's name, photographs of the physical premises, and a notarized rental licence confirming that the licensee operates a CMRA under Vietnamese municipal regulations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound foreign direct investment is routed exclusively through a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank. The remitting foreign shareholder must instruct its offshore bank to transmit the funds via SWIFT/MT103 in USD (or another convertible currency) to the DICA's account at the local depository bank. The payment must include a payment narrative citing the purpose code 'DIRECT INVESTMENT CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' (code 4.2) or 'SHARE CAPITAL PAYMENT' under the Vietnam Balance of Payments classification, along with the Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) of the Vietnamese LLC and the Investment Registration Certificate number. The bank will verify the remitting shareholder's identity, match the remittance amount to the capital schedule in the Investment Registration Certificate, and submit a Foreign Investment Supervision Notification to the State Bank of Vietnam within 48 hours. The funds are not available for operating expenditure until the bank confirms the receipt and the SBV's electronic portal flags the GIA consent, after which the bank may reclassify the funds from 'Escrowed, Pending Verification' to 'Available Current Account'. If capital is injected in tranches, each tranche requires a separate SWIFT/MT103 and a corresponding revised certificate or the company must file an adjustment notice with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment and the bank before the transfer.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade and service payments are executed through the Vietnam LLC's transactional foreign-currency account or domestic VND account, using SWIFT MT103 for cross-border fund transfers originating from a licensed bank. For trade settlement, the beneficiary is an overseas supplier; the bank will require presentation of the commercial invoice, shipping bill (for goods), service contract (for intangible services), and the corresponding 'IG' trade code to confirm the import obligation. The LLC may also settle trade obligations via an irrevocable documentary letter of credit (LC) opened by a Vietnamese commercial bank; such LC are routed through SWIFT MT700 and honoured against presenting banks' documents, payable at sight or by acceptance. The clearing rails used will be: (1) VND debit from the LLC's account converted to USD at the bank's daily published rate, followed by an MT103; (2) direct USD transfer from the FX account if retained funds are compliant with the surrender rules; and (3) a Commercial LC import line tied to the DICA. Where the offline CMRA payment flows are in the form of a commercial LC to the overseas IT or logistics vendor, the bank must verify the underlying contract to ensure that the LC is not a front for capital flight. All SWIFT payments are subject to a Foreign Currency Business Permit verification and the SBV's Electronic Foreign Exchange Reporting Module must be updated no later than the next working day.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward Contracts: bilateral contracts between the licensed bank and the LLC for a fixed exchange rate settled on a future date, requiring a demonstrated commercial-hedging underlying obligation (e.g., on expected monthly USD inflows from subscribers or a planned USD disbursement to a foreign AI provider), and subject to SBV's Daily Rate Band.

Currency Swaps: periodic swap of VND and USD cash flows (or USD/EUR) between the LLC and a licensed bank, provided the bank applies the SBV's maximum tenor limits and includes a required COP (Compliance and Operational Procedure) to ensure no speculative position is built up.

FX Options (Premium/Zero-Premium): limited to vanilla European-style options purchased from licensed credit institutions; covered-call or covered-put strategies require prior SBV approval; these instruments must be used consecutively with named trade-documentation.

Interest Rate Swap Coupled to a Cross-Currency Facility: used where the LLC's capital injection is a USD-denominated shareholder loan converted to VND; the swap is permissible if matched to the underlying loan agreement and the DICA, with clearing executed via an ISDA schedule.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) with an SBV-Approved Local Bank: residents are not permitted to enter NDFs offshore, but licensed domestic banks may structure an onshore NDF if the hedge is wholly on account of a fully-bilateral current-account exposure and the NDF is settled in VND at maturity, with foreign-currency difference delivered offshore outside SBV jurisdiction avoided; we do not recommend using an offshore NDF provider due to enforcement risk and pure outside clearability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee Declaration and Payment (Lệ phí môn bài) - Year 2 onwards after first-calendar-year exemption
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation via the managing provincial/district tax sub-department (Chi cục Thuế / Cục Thuế) and the e-Tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 30 January annually for the current calendar year; newly incorporated entities pay within 30 days of Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance and are exempt for the first year of operation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest at 0.03% per day on the overdue amount; administrative fines up to VND 25,000,000 (approx. USD 985) for non-declaration or under-declaration; enforced collection measures include bank account garnishment, asset seizure, and refusal of tax clearance certificates required for dissolution or license surrender.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Postal Service Operation Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động bưu chính) - Filed by holders of the non-universal postal service license applicable to CMRA mail-receiving and digital scanning activities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Information and Communications (MIC) / provincial Department of Information and Communications (DIC) - postal licensing division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 January annually for the preceding calendar year (periodic reporting obligation for licensed postal service providers under Decree 47/2020/ND-CP)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines for late, incomplete, or false postal periodic reporting under the postal-sector sanction regime; repeated or severe violations may lead to suspension or revocation of the postal service license and cessation of the mail-scanning service.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN) - Form 03/TNDN together with the annual audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Managing tax authority (provincial Cục Thuế or district Chi cục Thuế) via the e-Tax electronic portal (etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 30 March of the calendar year following the fiscal year end (no later than the 30th day of the 3rd month after the fiscal year end; extended to the next working day if the deadline falls on a holiday or weekend)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Escalating late-filing fines from VND 2,000,000 to VND 25,000,000 (approx. USD 80-985) depending on the number of days overdue; late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; penalty of 10-20% of the understated corporate income tax amount for misdeclaration plus interest; the tax authority may issue a forced assessment and enforce collection through bank garnishment and seizure of assets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm đã được kiểm toán) with the Independent Auditor's Report - Mandatory for all foreign-invested enterprises irrespective of size
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Managing tax authority (e-Tax portal), Business Registration Office of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), and the provincial statistics office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year end, by 31 March of the following calendar year (for a 1 January - 31 December fiscal year); the audit must be completed before the CIT finalization return is filed on 30 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late submission subjects the LLC to fines up to VND 20,000,000 (approx. USD 790); failure to arrange the mandatory audit for a foreign-invested enterprise exposes the LLC to fines up to VND 50,000,000 (approx. USD 1,970) and a requirement to re-publish corrected statements; the tax authority will reject the CIT finalization dossier until a conforming audited report is lodged with the DPI.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Operation Report with Updated Member List (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động của doanh nghiệp và danh sách thành viên) - Annual confirmation of legal-entity ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office - Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) via the National Business Registration Portal (Đăng ký doanh nghiệp quốc gia)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year end; by 31 March of the following calendar year (for a 31 December fiscal year end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP: VND 5,000,000-10,000,000 (approx. USD 195-395) for late submission exceeding 30 days, and VND 10,000,000-20,000,000 (approx. USD 395-790) for failure to submit; continuous failure to report operations for 6 consecutive months may lead to revocation of the Enterprise Registration Certificate and forced dissolution proceedings under Article 214 of the Enterprise Law 2020.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Personal Income Tax Finalization Return (Quyết toán thuế TNCN) - Form 05/QTT-TNCN, including employer employee finalization schedules where the LLC maintains a payroll
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Managing tax authority via the e-Tax electronic portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 March of the calendar year following the fiscal year end, covering both the filing and the payment of residual personal income tax liability
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Escalating late-filing fines up to VND 25,000,000 (approx. USD 985); late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; penalty of 10-20% of the underpaid personal income tax amount plus interest; willful failure exposes the legal representative to personal liability and, where the evasion threshold under the Penal Code is met, to criminal prosecution for tax evasion.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit under Decree 17/2012/ND-CP (as amended by Decree 07/2016/ND-CP) applies to this LLC by virtue of its status as a 100% foreign-invested enterprise (FIE), regardless of revenue, asset, or headcount thresholds; the compulsory audit also extends to public-interest entities (banks, insurance companies, securities firms, investment funds) and state-owned enterprises. Non-FIE enterprises are required to undergo independent audit when they satisfy the government-prescribed large-enterprise scale criteria or operate in supervised industries.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) pursuant to the Law on Accounting No. 88/2015/QH13, Decree 174/2016/ND-CP, and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC (Enterprise Accounting Regime); statutory financial statements are prepared in Vietnamese Dong (VND) using the VAS chart of accounts and statutory balance-sheet/income-statement templates; IFRS adoption is voluntary and limited to consolidated financial statements of qualifying parent companies under Circular 20/2020/TT-BTC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain a complete Register of Members at its head office and update it immediately upon any transfer of a capital contribution, forfeiture, or membership change; any change in ownership must be notified to the Business Registration Office (DPI) within 10 days of the change. The annual confirmation cycle is embedded in the Annual Enterprise Operation Report filed by 31 March, which restates the current list of members and their ownership percentages and therefore serves as the annual UBO/ownership confirmation filing. Under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 10/2022/QH15 and implementing decrees (notably Decree 19/2024/ND-CP), the LLC must identify, verify, and retain records of all beneficial owners (individuals ultimately owning or controlling 25% or more of the capital) on an ongoing basis and update those records upon any ownership transaction; a separate standalone public UBO annual return does not exist in Viet Nam, but the AML beneficial-ownership record combined with the annual member-list filing satisfies the statutory confirmation protocol.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Sổ đăng ký thành viên) - maintained at the head office and updated upon each capital transfer
Register of Directors / Members' Council (Sổ đăng ký thành viên Hội đồng thành viên and management records)
Minute Book (Sổ biên bản) containing all Member's Council resolutions, capital-transfer approvals, and annual general meeting minutes
Charter (Điều lệ công ty), Enterprise Registration Certificate, postal service license, and complete statutory dossier of the legal representative

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 240 - 600 per year (typical-market annual range in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City for registered-address corporate services, mail receiving and scanning, and compliance-agent representation)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 - 3,500 per annual engagement for a small foreign-invested services LLC (VAS statutory audit by a licensed independent audit firm, excluding any voluntary IFRS review)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday or preferential CIT rate applies to a virtual-office / mail-scanning CMRA business under ISIC 8299. The flat 20% standard rate applies. General incentive schemes (e.g., 2-year full exemption plus 4-year 50% reduction for new encouraged-sector projects, or 10% for 15 years for high-tech and specially encouraged sectors) are available only to qualifying manufacturing, software, and high-tech investment projects; business support services and virtual-office operations do not fall within those categories.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 01/TNDN (Tờ khai thuế TNDN tạm tính) - Quarterly provisional CIT return; filed electronically via HTKK software or the eTax portal etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn operated by the General Department of Taxation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 calendar days after the end of each quarter (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) for a calendar-year enterprise; the Q4 return is based on the actual quarter result.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue of the quarter from taxable business activities (mail-scanning service fees, virtual-office rental fees, mail-forwarding fees)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All revenue earned from Vietnamese-source customers and foreign remote customers through Stripe or cards must be declared; no distinction is drawn for non-resident owned LLCs because the LLC itself is the Vietnamese tax resident.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses directly incurred in the quarter (staff costs, rent, software subscriptions, bank fees, valid invoices)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recharges paid to a foreign parent or sister company (e.g., scanning software, cloud hosting, management fees) are deductible only if supported by contracts, invoices, and arm's-length transfer pricing evidence.
If negative, record a loss for carryforward treatment; no provisional CIT is payable for that quarter.
No reduced rate or holiday is available for ISIC 8299 CMRA services.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provisional CIT payable for the quarter (Line 3 × Line 4)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment must be remitted to the state budget via the electronic tax account; quarterly payments are credited against the annual final liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign contractor tax credits and other creditable withholding amounts
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the LLC paid royalties or interest to a foreign party, the FCT withheld is not an asset of the LLC; this line is for any domestic withholding tax credits the LLC is entitled to claim.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP: written warning for 1-5 days delay; VND 2,000,000-5,000,000 for 5-30 days; VND 5,000,000-8,000,000 for 31-60 days; VND 8,000,000-15,000,000 for 61-90 days; VND 15,000,000-30,000,000 for more than 90 days. Late payment interest accrues at 0.03% per day on the unpaid CIT amount.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 02/TNDN (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN) - Annual CIT finalization return; filed electronically via HTKK software or eTax portal etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn, with annexed audited financial statements and transfer pricing documentation Forms 01/02/03 where thresholds are met.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 90 days after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year LLC, no later than 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer name, tax code, investment registration certificate number, address of the CMRA, and schedule of all related parties
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC must disclose every foreign related party (shareholders, directors, affiliated enterprises) to enable the tax authority to map transfer pricing risk.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from business activities for the entire fiscal year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include recurring subscription revenue processed through Stripe or credit cards by foreign customers; foreign-source revenue of a resident LLC is fully taxable in Vietnam.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total deductible expenses reconciled to the audited financial statements
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border payments for software, scanning platforms, and management fees require legal invoices and detailed TP benchmarks; non-deductible or improperly documented items must be added back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before loss offset (Line 1 minus Line 2, adjusted for non-deductible items and TP adjustments)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Add back thin-capitalisation interest exceeding 30% EBITDA, gifts, fines, and any transfer-pricing re-determination imposed by the authority.
Only the Vietnamese LLC's own tax losses from the previous 5 consecutive years may be offset; losses of the foreign parent or overseas branches are not eligible.
If negative, no CIT is payable and the loss is carried forward.
The CMRA business does not qualify for any preferential rate.
This is the final tax obligation of the LLC; no additional withholding tax is levied on profit repatriation to the foreign shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly provisional CIT payments already made under Form 01/TNDN
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC must reconcile all four quarterly payments; underpayment of more than 20% of the final liability attracts interest at 0.03%/day from the first day after the quarterly deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance due to the state budget or overpayment credit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The after-tax profit reflected on the audited financial statements constitutes the distributable pool; a 0% dividend withholding tax applies to remittance to the foreign corporate investor.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual finalization triggers the same Decree 125/2020/ND-CP monetary tiers (up to VND 30,000,000) plus 0.03% daily interest on the unpaid final tax. Failure to submit transfer pricing forms or auditor-attached financial statements may add a 30% uplift on any recalculated tax due; intentional false declaration is referred to criminal prosecution under Penal Code Article 200.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends/profits remitted by a foreign-invested LLC to its non-resident corporate shareholders; Vietnam abolished the profit remittance tax in 2004. Dividends paid to resident or non-resident individuals are subject to personal income tax at 5%, but this does not apply to corporate profit repatriation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because no dividend withholding tax exists domestically, no DTA claim is required for dividend repatriation. For cross-border royalties and interest, the Vietnamese payor must withhold the statutory Foreign Contractor Tax rate; to invoke a reduced treaty rate, the foreign recipient must submit a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC), a beneficial ownership declaration, and a written application via eTax using Form 01/TWTS. The tax authority reviews and issues approval within approximately 30-60 days; the reduced rate is applied once approved and any over-withholding is refundable.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates for Foreign Contractor Tax: royalties - CIT 10% plus VAT 5% (aggregate 15% of gross payment); interest on loans - CIT 5% and VAT 0% (aggregate 5%). Typical DTA rates negotiated by Vietnam may reduce royalties to 10-15% and interest to 5-10%; the taxpayer can invoke the lower domestic or treaty rate upon TRC-based approval.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File (Form 02) and Master File (Form 01) are mandatory if the LLC's total related-party transaction value in the year exceeds VND 30 billion, or if total revenue exceeds VND 50 billion and related-party transaction value exceeds VND 10 billion; Country-by-Country Report (Form 03) is required when the ultimate consolidated group revenue reaches VND 18,000 billion. A CMRA LLC typically operates below these thresholds but must still apply arm's-length pricing and keep contemporaneous documentation on demand.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam does not have a UAE-style standalone ESR regime, but Decree 132/2020/ND-CP fully incorporates the OECD BEPS substance-over-form principle and a general anti-avoidance rule. Transactions lacking commercial substance are recharacterized by the tax authority; thin capitalisation limits interest deductions to 30% of EBITDA; controlled-foreign-company rules apply; and a CMRA LLC with only a virtual mailbox, no local employees, and no genuine activity is treated as a shell and highly vulnerable to being recharacterized as a pure tax vehicle.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion under Penal Code Article 200
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willfully under-declaring recurring mail-scanning and virtual-office subscription revenue collected via Stripe or credit cards; using fabricated invoices or ghost vendors to inflate deductible expenses; failing to declare cross-border digital payment receipts; deliberately omitting related-party income to reduce the 20% CIT base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to VND 4.5 billion; imprisonment of individuals from 6 months up to 7 years for the basic offence, extending up to 20 years for extraordinary amounts; legal entities face fine up to VND 4.5 billion, suspension of operations, or forced dissolution; plus administrative penalties equal to the evaded tax and 0.03% daily late-payment interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and day-to-day managers who order or participate in tax evasion face personal criminal prosecution, passport confiscation, travel bans, asset freezes, and civil restitution orders for the evaded CIT; piercing of the corporate veil is applied so the personal assets of the culpable director answer for the unpaid tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Non-Compliance and Thin Capitalisation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging a foreign related party a non-arm's-length mail-scanning processing fee or failing to set a service margin consistent with the TNMM benchmark; failing to prepare Local File and Master File when the VND 30 billion related-party threshold or VND 50 billion revenue threshold is crossed; deducting interest above the 30% EBITDA cap without qualifying exceptions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority re-determines taxable income using the best-fit arm's-length methodology and imposes additional CIT of up to 30% of the recalculated income, plus 0.03% daily late-payment interest; documentation deficiency fines reach VND 15,000,000 under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; investigation files may be criminally referred under Tax Administration Law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certify false TP documentation or approve fictitious cross-border service contracts are personally liable for the penalty uplift; the law permits director disqualification, travel restrictions, and criminal prosecution for signing fraudulent subsidy? (i.e., fraudulent expense) declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Abuse of Limited Liability
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the virtual-office CMRA as a letterbox entity with no employees, no physical premises infrastructure, and no actual business decision-making in Vietnam; using nominee shareholders to obscure the beneficial owner; obtaining the CMRA statutory licence by supplying false information; claiming Vietnamese tax residency or DTA benefits without real substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the Investment Registration Certificate and Enterprise Registration Certificate; forced dissolution; denial of treaty benefits and recharacterization of all related-party revenue as deemed dividends; administrative fines for false licensing declarations; criminal prosecution for document forgery and fraud with imprisonment up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts pierce the corporate veil of the shell, rendering the foreign parent and its directors jointly and severally liable for all unpaid corporate taxes and creditor claims; directors face entry bans, travel bans, confiscation of local assets, and criminal sentences for abuse of legal personality.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering / KYC Violations in CMRA Operations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing recurring Stripe or credit-card subscriptions without performing proper customer identification and beneficial-ownership verification of corporate clients; allowing the mail-scanning mailbox to be used as a fake business address for fraud, phishing, cryptocurrency scams, or invoice laundering; failing to file Suspicious Transaction Reports with the State Bank of Vietnam; knowingly handling proceeds of crime through invoiced scanning fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to VND 5 billion under Decree 87/2023/ND-CP on anti-money laundering; criminal liability for money laundering under Penal Code Article 324 with imprisonment of 1-10 years for individuals and up to 15 years for aggravated organized conduct; revocation of the CMRA licence and exclusion from payment-processing channels.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners face personal fines, asset seizure, travel bans, and imprisonment; the court may impose a management ban and order personal restitution to defrauded third parties when the director knowingly allowed the platform to facilitate laundering.
